observation: The owner requested consolidation of repeated customer corrections into an evidence-bound drawing workflow.
cause: Inherited inventory, generic symbols, coincident polygon edges, and reusable success flags can preserve a source interpretation error.
proposed_rule: Trace the customer target and every contributor, preserve source-specific notation and construction coordination, bind dimensions independently, and attach separate review results to exact artifact hashes.
verification_scope: Instruction-level decision cases and skill structural checks only; no new certification of historical drawings.
